filesToTouch.what: Add export const commodityBulkDetailsPage = { id: 'commodity-bulk-details', slug: 'commodity-bulk-details' }. File stays import-free (controller/flow both import the same object).

export const meta = { ...commodityBulkDetailsPage, collects: [] } (the commodityLines root is owned by commodity-search; members inherit dispatch coverage from the group — exemplar: live-animals consignment-details.controller.js:29). GET: state.get() once; state.collectionView(answers, ['commodityLines']) for facts; build per-line view rows (code + ref-data description from the pp-014 commodities service) prefilled from each entry's nine measure leaves; empty bulk panel. POST branches on the named submit action (documents-exemplar pattern — action travels as a submit button value so the crumb rides along, no GET mutation): (a) action='apply' — validate ≥1 line checkbox selected ('Select at least one commodity line to apply changes to') and ≥1 of the six bulk fields filled ('Fill in at least one field to update the selected commodity lines'); each FILLED bulk value also passes its field's format rule; then COPY each filled value onto every selected line via state.updateEntryAt(request, h, ['commodityLines'], index, entry) per selected index (copy-per-line, never apportion — v16 ruling) and 302 back to this page (server round-trip, zero client JS); bulk values are UI only, never persisted as answers. (b) action='clear' — re-render with an empty bulk panel, per-line values untouched (fixes the legacy Clear-by-reload trap; no write). (c) default Save and continue — validate EVERY line's measures with lib/validate factories (canonical strings in copyKeys); invalid → 400 re-render raw values; valid → commit each line in place via state.updateEntryAt wrapped in kit.recoverableSave (marked failure → recoverableError re-render 500; unexpected errors throw); exit via await kit.nextTarget(request, page, committed.scope) with kit.hubExitTarget(request) winning first. Every line index guarded before any write: Number.isInteger(index) && index >= 0 && index < lines.length — refuse forged/stale indexes with no write. finishedOrPropagated is rendered+validated only for lines whose commodity code the pp-014 fixture flags as requiring intended-use (plants-for-planting analogue); never commit a value for a line where the control did not render.

GET prefill from seeded lines; apply branch: values copied to selected lines only, unselected lines untouched, partial bulk fill copies only filled fields; 'Select at least one commodity line…' when none selected; 'Fill in at least one field…' when all six empty; clear branch resets bulk panel without touching line data; each per-line validation rule its own test (required x5, whole-number packages, quantity format, net-weight min/decimals/digits, finishedOrPropagated required-when-rendered); raw values + no commit on 400; cleaned commit via updateEntryAt + redirect on success; finishedOrPropagated absent (not rendered, not validated, not committed) for a non-flagged line; forged/out-of-range index refused with no write; recoverable-save failure → 500; unexpected error throws.

Extends shared/layout.njk (unprefixed). Caption 'Description of the goods' + H1 'Commodity details' (single H1 — c-014 family). Shared error summary ('There is a problem' — c-004). Bulk-apply panel: govukCheckboxes 'Select all' + one checkbox per line whose visible label names the commodity meaningfully (code + description — fixes the legacy 'commodity-<uuid>' screen-reader name defect), six bulk controls (govukInput number of packages / quantity / net weight; govukSelect package type / quantity type from pp-016 fixtures; govukRadios yes/no controlled atmosphere), Apply + Clear as named submit buttons (govuk-button / govuk-button--secondary — no bespoke .link-button, no reload-Clear). Then one govukFieldset per commodity line (legend = code + ref-data description) with the per-line controls: govukInput numberOfPackages/quantity/netWeight, govukSelect packageType (24 opts) / quantityType (8 opts) from pp-016, govukRadios controlledAtmosphereContainer (true/false), govukRadios finishedOrPropagated with values FINISHED/PROPAGATED asking the domain question directly (v17 ruling — never a Yes/No veneer), govukRadios intendedForFinalUsers (true/false), govukCheckboxes testAndTrial. EVERY control gets a real macro-emitted label/legend — no aria-label-only controls, no aria-labelledby (the two legacy a11y defects this increment fixes by construction). Derived read-only per-line and consignment subtotals (Σ netWeight, Σ packages) rendered from the data — no 'Update total' button (totals always fresh; legacy stale-display + button not ported). Input name = id = error key throughout so error-summary links focus controls. May extract a _line-fields.njk partial per the consignment-details exemplar. Govuk macros only, no custom CSS.

Add the commodityBulkDetails namespace: caption 'Description of the goods', title/heading 'Commodity details', bulk panel copy (heading 'Apply to all commodity lines', 'Select all', 'Apply', 'Clear'), field labels ('Number of packages', 'Type of package', 'Quantity', 'Quantity type', 'Net weight (kg)', 'Controlled atmosphere container' — sentence case everywhere, resolving the legacy bulk-vs-grid casing split), finishedOrPropagated legend + option labels naming the domain values (finished / to be grown on), intendedForFinalUsers legend + yes/no, testAndTrial label 'For test and trial', and ALL validation strings (see copyKeys — one canonical string per rule, c-018 Enter/Select voice).

acceptanceCriteria: GET /notifications/{journeyId}/commodity-bulk-details renders caption 'Description of the goods', single H1 'Commodity details', one fieldset per commodityLines entry (legend = commodity code + ref-data description from the pp-014 service) and the bulk-apply panel.

EVERY form control has a real macro-emitted <label>/<legend> programmatically associated (getByLabel resolves each one); zero aria-label-only controls and zero aria-labelledby attributes — the two legacy defects (grid controls named only by aria-label; self-referential aria-labelledby on bulk selects) cannot recur.
Line-selection checkboxes are labelled with the commodity code + description, never an internal id (fixes the 'commodity-<uuid>' accessible-name defect).

finishedOrPropagated is asked as the domain enum — option values FINISHED and PROPAGATED with labels naming the real meanings — not a Yes/No (v17 ruling); it renders and validates only for lines the commodities fixture flags, and is never committed for a line where it did not render.

controlledAtmosphereContainer, intendedForFinalUsers and testAndTrial submit a single stable boolean vocabulary (true/false); the four legacy Yes/No encodings (on/off, 1364882/'', Finished/Propagated-as-Yes/No) are not ported.

Apply copies each FILLED bulk value onto EVERY selected line (copy-per-line then sum — v16 semantics; never apportion), leaves unselected lines and unfilled fields untouched, is a full server round-trip (POST → 302 → GET, zero client XHR), and persists no bulk value as an answer.
Apply with no line selected → 'Select at least one commodity line to apply changes to'; Apply with all six bulk fields empty → 'Fill in at least one field to update the selected commodity lines'.

Save and continue validates every line with exactly one canonical string per rule in the Enter/Select voice (c-018): the five required strings, 'Number of packages must be a whole number', the quantity format string, and the three net-weight strings; invalid POST re-renders the user's raw values with status 400 and a GDS 'There is a problem' summary whose links focus the offending control.

Valid save commits cleaned values in place via state.updateEntryAt per line (parent index guarded with Number.isInteger + bounds before any write; forged index → no write) inside kit.recoverableSave, then redirects via kit.nextTarget with kit.hubExitTarget winning; marked persistence failure re-renders recoverableError with status 500.
Per-line and consignment subtotals (Σ net weight, Σ packages) are derived and rendered fresh on every GET — there is no 'Update total' button and no stored rollup.

The commodities task row shows In progress while any line's mandatory measures are missing and Completed when all lines are complete; the contract case in contract.plant-products.test.js asserts meta.collects === [] and the nine leaves committing in place.
Axe (wcag2a/wcag2aa) reports no serious/critical violation in either state; the full plant verification ladder is green and npm test (L1 composition + conventions) passes unchanged.
